task_metadata.research_topic: data augmentation strategy design for image classification
task_metadata.research_question: Design a novel data augmentation strategy for image classification that improves test accuracy across different architectures and datasets.
notes: Baselines and evaluation settings were read from the local config and task description.
The canonical CIFAR citation currently resolves through a DOI-backed archival record for Krizhevsky's original tiny-images technical report.
